question: A vector-resolution model uses two perpendicular vectors $\vec{a}=2\hat{i}-\hat{j}+2\hat{k}$ and $\vec{b}=\hat{i}+2\hat{j}$. A resultant is formed as $\vec{r}=2\vec{a}-3\vec{b}$. Since the original vectors are perpendicular, the coefficients in this expression determine the components of the resultant along their respective directions. Students calculate the resultant and use scalar products to measure its signed projections along the two original vectors.(a) Verify that $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ are perpendicular.(b) Calculate $2\vec{a}$ and $-3\vec{b}$.(c) Determine $\vec{r}$ and its magnitude.(d) Find the scalar projections of $\vec{r}$ on $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$.
explanation: (a)`\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}=(2)(1)+(-1)(2)+(2)(0)=0`Since their scalar product is zero, $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ are perpendicular.(b)`2\vec{a}=4\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+4\hat{k}`Also,`-3\vec{b}=-3\hat{i}-6\hat{j}`(c)`\vec{r}=2\vec{a}-3\vec{b}\vec{r}=(4\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+4\hat{k})+(-3\hat{i}-6\hat{j})\vec{r}=\hat{i}-8\hat{j}+4\hat{k}`Its magnitude is`|\vec{r}|=\sqrt{1^2+(-8)^2+4^2}=9`(d)The scalar projection of $\vec{r}$ on $\vec{a}$ is`\frac{\vec{r}\cdot\vec{a}}{|\vec{a}|}`Now,`\vec{r}\cdot\vec{a}=(1)(2)+(-8)(-1)+(4)(2)=18`and $|\vec{a}|=3$. Therefore, the scalar projection is`\frac{18}{3}=6`The scalar projection of $\vec{r}$ on $\vec{b}$ is`\frac{\vec{r}\cdot\vec{b}}{|\vec{b}|}`Now,`\vec{r}\cdot\vec{b}=(1)(1)+(-8)(2)+(4)(0)=-15`and $|\vec{b}|=\sqrt{5}$. Therefore, the scalar projection is`\frac{-15}{\sqrt{5}}=-3\sqrt{5}`

options.A:
(a) $\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}=0$
(b) $2\vec{a}=4\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$, $-3\vec{b}=-3\hat{i}-6\hat{j}$
(c) $\vec{r}=\hat{i}-8\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$, $|\vec{r}|=9$
(d) Scalar projections on $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ are $3$ and $-3\sqrt{5}$
options.B:
(a) $\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}=0$, so $\vec{a}\perp\vec{b}$
(b) $2\vec{a}=4\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$, $-3\vec{b}=-3\hat{i}-6\hat{j}$
(c) $\vec{r}=\hat{i}-8\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$, $|\vec{r}|=9$
(d) Scalar projections of $\vec{r}$ on $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$ are $6$ and $-3\sqrt{5}$ respectively
options.D:
(a) $\vec{a}\cdot\vec{b}=4$, so the vectors are not perpendicular
(b) $2\vec{a}=4\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$, $-3\vec{b}=-3\hat{i}-6\hat{j}$
(c) $\vec{r}=\hat{i}-8\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$, $|\vec{r}|=\sqrt{79}$
(d) Scalar projections are $6$ and $3\sqrt{5}$
